{{Youmay|the negrav trampoline|the [[null-grav trampoline]]}}
A giant '''negrav trampoline''' was installed at [[Mungo Park]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Antigrav/Legends|anti-gravity]] trampoline allowed [[Youngling/Legends|children]] playing on it to somersault high in the air, and their squealing and laughing was witnessed by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]]<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'' in [[44 ABY]].</ref> when the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|war]] between the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] and [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] had broken out across Coruscant.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

==Behind the scenes==
The negrav trampoline was introduced in the [[2012]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]] as the finale to the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
